summary: The run successfully produced high-quality documentation for 9/11 modules following the correct template, with a functional INDEX.md, Mermaid dependency graph, and enriched dependency sections citing specific cross-file function calls. The three critical gaps are: (1) infrastructure and scrapy-__main__ DETAIL.md files (covering ~74 source files) were written by the main agent using an ad-hoc '### File:' prose format instead of the standard <!-- file:xxx --> block template — these two modules account for R5b, R7, P3, V5, and S2 failures and the fix is mechanical; (2) Phase 4 heading renaming was not executed — ## headings and Mermaid node labels still use module_id names despite explicit Skill instructions; (3) source file coverage is 56.45%, 23.5 percentage points below the required 80% gate. All nine failures are agent_error — the Skill documentation is clear and sufficient. The root cause appears to be the agent switching to a different documentation format when writing large/infrastructure modules directly instead of delegating to sub-agents, then failing to execute the post-write validation that would have caught the format deviation.
